verdict.rationale: Poke supports building and sharing 'recipes' via MCP servers that extend Poke with custom tools/data sources and can be monetized when others install them, which is adjacent to building/sharing custom assistant capabilities. However there is no explicit evidence of persona-style custom instructions or an attached knowledge base akin to a custom assistant builder. Missing for 10: documented feature for defining custom instructions/persona, knowledge base attachment, and sharing complete assistant personas (not just tool recipes).
